title: Improved docs link contrast in light mode
points: Underlined in-text docs links now use a brighter dedicated orange color in light mode instead of the pale primary accent used for filled controls.
Artifact toggles and trace-stage action labels now use the same stronger docs action color so they remain readable in light mode.
The change stays scoped to docs text actions so card links, icon links, the main app theme, and button backgrounds keep their original colors.
